notes: Dated: the council listing for the half-term play day, Tuesday 27 October 2026, 10:00 to 15:00, category 'Ages 5-12'. Regular: term-time sessions for ages 5 to 15 on Tuesdays to Thursdays, 3:30 to 6pm, from the council parks directory (undated). The directory says 'Adventure Playground for ages 8 and above' and that children under 8 need an adult. One WebSearch found only council pages; no own website. The council listing prints the postcode 'E1 ONZ' with a letter O, which is not valid and was not used (facts lane). The editor declined this venue last week as not a nights-out venue.
